description: This file defines classes and interfaces related to detecting transaction overloads in Orleans transactions, including options for load shedding, implementation of detector logic, and methods for statistical calculation.

classes.name: ITransactionOverloadDetector
classes.description: Interface defining the transaction overload detection capability, with method to determine if system is overloaded.

classes.name: TransactionRateLoadSheddingOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for load shedding based on transaction rate, including enable flag and limit value.

classes.name: TransactionOverloadDetector
classes.description: Implements overload detection logic based on transaction rates, utilizing statistical data and periodic checks.

methods.name: RecordStatistics
methods.description: Records current transaction statistics and updates the TPS calculation.

methods.name: IsOverloaded
methods.description: Determines if the system is overloaded based on current transaction rates and configured limits.
